basic_profile.bio: I'm a 38-year-old male living in Pittsburgh, USA. I have a passion for languages and enjoy connecting with people from different cultures. I used to teach ESL to Chinese international students and picked up some Mandarin along the way. My goal now is to relearn Mandarin, especially conversational phrases for dining and small talk. I work as a freelance graphic designer, which gives me a flexible schedule, though I usually work late into the night. I'm single and enjoy spending my weekends exploring new tech gadgets or reading romance novels. My typical online hours are late evenings, often past midnight.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design and have been working as a freelance designer for the past 10 years. My interest in languages began with my work as an ESL tutor, where I developed a methodical approach to language acquisition, focusing on practical usage and cultural nuances.
